sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们从比尔·克林顿开始。

sentences.zh: 他在这次国情咨文中确实阐明了伊拉克战争的终局。

sentences.en: It actually proves to be a very, very accurate predictor of how things play out.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，这确实是一个非常、非常准确的预测，预示了事态的发展。

sentences.en: Right now, we're looking at a live picture of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们看到的是美国国会大厦的现场画面，

sentences.en: Capitol, where the Republicans will seize control of the House of Representatives.
sentences.zh: 共和党人即将在这里夺取众议院的控制权。

sentences.en: It's picking up more than 60 seats now.
sentences.zh: 他们现在已经赢得了超过60个席位。

sentences.en: Ohio's John Boehner now stands to become the next speaker, replacing Nancy Pelosi.
sentences.zh: 俄亥俄州的约翰·博纳即将接替南希·佩洛西，成为下一任议长。

sentences.en: He already got a call from...
sentences.zh: 他已经接到了一个电话……

sentences.en: And then came President Obama, who spoke before Congress in January 2011, three months after his party lost control of Congress.
sentences.zh: 随后是奥巴马总统，他在2011年1月，即其所在政党失去国会控制权三个月后，在国会发表了演讲。

sentences.en: The American people have sent an unmistakable message to him tonight.
sentences.zh: 美国人民今晚向他传达了一个明确无误的信息。

sentences.en: And that message is, change course.
sentences.zh: 那个信息就是：改变方针。

sentences.en: And left this young president very much on his back foot.
sentences.zh: 这让这位年轻的总统陷入了非常被动的境地。

sentences.en: Tonight, I want to begin by congratulating the men and women of the 112th Congress, as well as your new speaker, John Boehner.
sentences.zh: 今晚，我想首先祝贺第112届国会的议员们，以及你们的新议长约翰·博纳。

sentences.en: And how did Obama's State of the Union confront that?
sentences.zh: 奥巴马的国情咨文是如何应对这一局面的呢？

sentences.en: Well, Obama responds to this setback, to this defeat, not by being contrite or acknowledging error.
sentences.zh: 嗯，奥巴马回应这一挫折、这一失败的方式，并不是表现出悔意或承认错误。

sentences.en: For the challenges we face are bigger than party, bigger than politics.
sentences.zh: 因为我们面临的挑战超越了党派，超越了政治。

sentences.en: But by, in effect, pushing past it.
sentences.zh: 而是实际上，选择无视它，继续前行。

sentences.en: At stake right now is not who wins the next election.
sentences.zh: 现在面临风险的不是谁会赢得下一次选举。

sentences.en: After all, we just had an election.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，我们刚刚才进行了一场选举。

sentences.en: By brushing it aside, by saying there are bigger things that we need to focus on than petty politics.
sentences.zh: 通过将其搁置一旁，通过说我们有比琐碎的政治更重要的事情需要关注。

sentences.en: At stake is whether new jobs and industries take root in this country or somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 面临风险的是，新的就业机会和产业是在这个国家扎根，还是在其他地方。

sentences.en: Essentially by ignoring it.
sentences.zh: 本质上就是通过忽视它。

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: The future is ours to win.
sentences.zh: 未来掌握在我们手中，等待我们去赢得。

sentences.en: But to get there, we can't just stand still.
sentences.zh: 但要实现这一点，我们不能原地踏步。

sentences.en: So it was a very soaring message that was in keeping with the way President Obama ran for office.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常宏大的信息，与奥巴马总统竞选时的风格保持一致。

sentences.en: But one that didn't necessarily acknowledge the defeat that his party had just suffered.
sentences.zh: 但这一信息并没有真正承认他所在的政党刚刚遭受的失败。

sentences.en: So does the way that Obama responds to this division in this speech, by kind of ignoring it, by not fully acknowledging the new political terrain he has to confront,
sentences.zh: 那么，奥巴马在演讲中通过某种程度上忽视这种分歧，通过没有完全承认他必须面对的新政治格局来回应，

sentences.en: does this forecast how he ends up working with Congress for the next two years?
sentences.zh: 这是否预示了他未来两年将如何与国会共事？

sentences.en: I think it does, quite accurately.
sentences.zh: 我认为确实如此，而且非常准确。

sentences.en: Because if you look at what happens in the years after this,
sentences.zh: 因为如果你看看此后几年发生的事情，

sentences.en: President Obama never really does form a good working relationship.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统从未真正建立起良好的工作关系。

sentences.en: He never really does roll up his sleeves and attempt to find much common ground with Republicans in Congress.
sentences.zh: 他从未真正卷起袖子，试图与国会的共和党人寻找共同点。

sentences.en: And so to some extent, these grand ideas remain just that, grand ideas, because he wasn't able to work with Republicans to translate them into more of a tangible reality.
sentences.zh: 因此在某种程度上，这些宏大的想法仅仅停留在想法层面，因为他没能与共和党人合作，将它们转化为更切实的现实。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So in that sense, the speech was a very honest and accurate predictor.
sentences.zh: 所以从这个意义上说，这次演讲是一个非常诚实且准确的预测。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: Okay, so it is 7.52, Mark, a little over an hour before President Trump gives his State of the Union.
sentences.zh: 好的，现在是7点52分，马克，距离特朗普总统发表国情咨文还有一个多小时。

sentences.en: Given the history you've just described, what do you expect his message to be now that he has divided government?
sentences.zh: 鉴于你刚才描述的历史，在他面临分裂政府的情况下，你认为他会传达什么信息？

sentences.en: We don't know exactly what he's going to say, but we do know that whatever their difference is, all three of his predecessors issued a call for unity.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道他具体会说什么，但我们确实知道，无论他们之间有什么分歧，他的三位前任都发出了团结的呼吁。

sentences.en: Unity is the one theme that we can almost certainly expect to hear in virtually any State of the Union address.
sentences.zh: 团结几乎是任何国情咨文中我们肯定会听到的一个主题。

sentences.en: But what's really interesting is less that than what's between the lines, what's the subtext or the nuance in the State of the Union address,
sentences.zh: 但真正有趣的是，比起这个，更重要的是字里行间的内容，即国情咨文中的潜台词或细微差别，

sentences.en: that's where you can really see what the president plans to do, how he plans to govern, what blueprint or what predicate he's putting in place.
sentences.zh: 那才是你真正能看出总统打算做什么、打算如何治理、正在制定什么蓝图或前提的地方。

sentences.en: So what's going to be interesting in President Trump's address is not a call for unity.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普总统演讲中真正有趣的地方将不会是呼吁团结。

sentences.en: It's almost certainly going to be there.
sentences.zh: 那几乎肯定会出现在演讲中。

sentences.en: It's the other things that are in the speech that are going to really tell you what we can expect.
sentences.zh: 演讲中其他的内容才会真正告诉你我们可以期待什么。

sentences.en: So, Mark, thank you for now.
sentences.zh: 那么，马克，先谢谢你。

sentences.en: We will talk to you after Trump's State of the Union in, I guess, an hour or two.
sentences.zh: 我想我们会在一两个小时后，在特朗普发表完国情咨文后再和你交谈。

sentences.en: Look forward to it.
sentences.zh: 我很期待。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: So, Mark, what did President Trump do tonight?
sentences.zh: 那么，马克，特朗普总统今晚做了什么？

sentences.en: Well, when President Trump took the rostrum in the House chamber tonight...
sentences.zh: 嗯，当特朗普总统今晚走上众议院议事厅的讲台时……

sentences.en: Thank you very much, Madam Speaker.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，议长女士。

sentences.en: He uttered the phrase Madam Speaker in deference to Nancy Pelosi, but he avoided giving her any further congratulations on taking up her position.
sentences.zh: 他出于对南希·佩洛西的尊重说了“议长女士”这个称呼，但他避免了对她就任该职位表示进一步的祝贺。

sentences.en: We meet tonight at a moment of unlimited potential.
sentences.zh: 我们今晚相聚在充满无限潜力的时刻。

sentences.en: He did nevertheless start off with...
sentences.zh: 但他确实以……作为开场。

sentences.en: As we begin a new Congress, I stand here ready to work with you to achieve historic breakthroughs for all Americans.
sentences.zh: 随着新一届国会的开始，我站在这里，准备与你们合作，为所有美国人实现历史性的突破。

sentences.en: A pretty standard call for bipartisanship and for unity.
sentences.zh: 这是一个相当标准的对两党合作和团结的呼吁。

sentences.en: Hoping that we will govern not as two parties, but as one nation.
sentences.zh: 希望我们治理国家不是作为两个政党，而是作为一个国家。

sentences.en: He said at one point...
sentences.zh: 他在演讲中曾一度表示……

sentences.en: Victory is not winning for our party.
sentences.zh: 胜利不是为了我们党获胜。

sentences.en: Victory is not winning for our party.
sentences.zh: 胜利不是为了我们党获胜。

sentences.en: Victory is winning for our country.
sentences.zh: 胜利是为了我们的国家获胜。

sentences.en: From there, he sort of segued into the economic achievements of his administration.
sentences.zh: 从那里，他转而谈到了他政府的经济成就。

sentences.en: In just over two years, since the election, we have launched an unprecedented economic boom.
sentences.zh: 在选举后的短短两年多时间里，我们开启了前所未有的经济繁荣。

sentences.en: But at that point, he took a distinct turn in tone.
sentences.zh: 但在那一点之后，他的语气发生了明显的转变。

sentences.en: An economic miracle is taking place in the United States, and the only thing that can stop it...
sentences.zh: 美国正在发生经济奇迹，唯一能阻止它的……

sentences.en: He basically said at this point...
sentences.zh: 他基本上在这一点上说……

sentences.en: ...are foolish wars, politics, or ridiculous partisan investigations.
sentences.zh: ……是愚蠢的战争、政治或荒谬的党派调查。

sentences.en: There can't be any cooperation on legislation if there's going to be what he called ridiculous partisan investigations of his presidency.
sentences.zh: 如果存在他所谓的对他总统任期的荒谬党派调查，立法上就不可能有任何合作。

sentences.en: This was a reference not only to potential future investigations by Congress, but also the Mueller investigation.
sentences.zh: 这不仅是指国会未来可能进行的调查，也指穆勒调查。

sentences.en: If there is going to be peace and legislation, there cannot be war and investigation.
sentences.zh: 如果要有和平与立法，就不能有战争与调查。

sentences.en: It just doesn't work that way.
sentences.zh: 事情不是那样运作的。

sentences.en: And he actually put a fairly menacing tone on it.
sentences.zh: 而且他实际上在这一点上表现出了相当威胁的语气。

sentences.en: Now is the time for bipartisan action.
sentences.zh: 现在是两党采取行动的时候了。

sentences.en: Believe it or not, we have already proven that that's possible.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，我们已经证明这是可能的。

sentences.en: From there, he turns to a more bipartisan issue.
sentences.zh: 从那里，他转向了一个更具两党共识的问题。

sentences.en: Criminal justice reform.
sentences.zh: 刑事司法改革。

sentences.en: They said it couldn't be done.
sentences.zh: 他们说这不可能做到。

sentences.en: But almost immediately...
sentences.zh: 但几乎立刻……

sentences.en: Now, Republicans and Democrats must join forces again to confront an urgent national crisis.
sentences.zh: 现在，共和党人和民主党人必须再次联手，应对一场紧迫的国家危机。

sentences.en: He then segues into immigration, talks about the virtues and importance of building a wall.
sentences.zh: 随后他转入移民问题，谈到了修建边境墙的优点和重要性。

sentences.en: Wealthy politicians and donors push for open borders.
sentences.zh: 富有的政客和捐赠者推动开放边境。

sentences.en: And accuses the political elite of being divided from ordinary working class Americans.
sentences.zh: 并指责政治精英与普通工薪阶层美国人脱节。

sentences.en: While living their lives behind walls and gates and guards.
sentences.zh: 同时他们却生活在围墙、大门和警卫的保护之下。

sentences.en: So the language here is extremely uncompromising.
sentences.zh: 所以这里的语言是非常不妥协的。

sentences.en: Simply put, walls work and walls save lives.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，围墙有效，围墙能拯救生命。

sentences.en: And this toggling continues throughout the speech.
sentences.zh: 这种切换贯穿了整个演讲。

sentences.en: Two weeks ago, the United States officially recognized the legitimate government of Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 两周前，美国正式承认了委内瑞拉的合法政府。

sentences.en: At one point, he's talking about the global coalition to force out a tyrant, an autocrat in Venezuela.
sentences.zh: 他一度在谈论迫使委内瑞拉的暴君、独裁者下台的全球联盟。

sentences.en: And yet in his next breath...
sentences.zh: 然而在下一刻……

sentences.en: Here in the United States, we are alarmed by the new calls to adopt socialism in our country.
sentences.zh: 在美国，我们对国内要求采纳社会主义的新呼声感到震惊。

sentences.en: He's likening this new class of Democrats in Congress to socialists.
sentences.zh: 他将国会中这批新的民主党人比作社会主义者。

sentences.en: America was founded on liberty and independence.
sentences.zh: 美国建立在自由和独立的基础之上。

sentences.en: And saying America will never be a socialist country.
sentences.zh: 并称美国永远不会成为一个社会主义国家。

sentences.en: We are born free and we will stay free.
sentences.zh: 我们生而自由，也将保持自由。

sentences.en: But it sounds like you think that the conciliatory language is just the obligatory language of the State of the Union.
sentences.zh: 但听起来你认为这种和解的语言只是国情咨文的例行公事。

sentences.en: And it's the harder-edged stuff that we should be listening to and thinking about in relation to past State of the Unions that you outlined before.
sentences.zh: 而那些强硬的内容才是我们应该倾听并结合你之前概述的过去国情咨文来思考的。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我确实这么认为。

sentences.en: I think that if you look at the things the president talks about that are more conciliatory, they tend to be on the level of symbolism.
sentences.zh: 我认为，如果你看看总统谈到的那些更具和解性的内容，它们往往停留在象征意义的层面。

sentences.en: In recent years, we have made remarkable progress in the fight against HIV and AIDS.
sentences.zh: 近年来，我们在抗击艾滋病毒和艾滋病方面取得了显著进展。

sentences.en: A campaign to fight AIDS with no dollar sign attached to it.
sentences.zh: 一项没有附带资金要求的抗击艾滋病运动。

sentences.en: A campaign to fight cancer in children with no specifics attached to it.
sentences.zh: 一项没有具体细节的抗击儿童癌症运动。

sentences.en: My budget will ask Congress for $500 million over the next 10 years to fund this critical life-saving research.
sentences.zh: 我的预算将要求国会在未来10年内拨款5亿美元，用于资助这项关键的救命研究。

sentences.en: While the areas where he's hard-edged are really the ones that matter to the future direction of governance and of his relationship with Congress.
sentences.zh: 而他立场强硬的领域，才是真正关系到未来治理方向以及他与国会关系的问题。

sentences.en: Whether he resolves this issue over funding the wall and more broadly,
sentences.zh: 他是否能解决边境墙资金问题，以及更广泛地来说，

sentences.en: whether he and the Democrats ever come to terms on immigration is really a core issue of how the rest of the Trump presidency will play out.
sentences.zh: 他和民主党人是否能在移民问题上达成一致，这确实是特朗普总统任期余下部分如何发展的核心问题。

sentences.en: That much more than these conciliatory stories, these nice images, are really what matter in this speech.
sentences.zh: 比起这些和解的故事、这些美好的画面，这才是这次演讲中真正重要的内容。

sentences.en: And I think the speechwriters were very careful to lard this speech with this kind of uplifting material.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为演讲撰稿人非常小心地在这次演讲中加入了这类鼓舞人心的材料。

sentences.en: In 2019, we also celebrate 50 years since brave young pilots flew a quarter of a million miles through space to plant the American flag on the face of the moon.
sentences.zh: 2019年，我们也庆祝勇敢的年轻飞行员穿越25万英里太空，将美国国旗插在月球表面50周年。

sentences.en: To make it more attractive to a broad audience while also speaking to the president's political base.
sentences.zh: 为了让演讲对更广泛的受众更具吸引力，同时也为了迎合总统的政治基本盘。

sentences.en: But make no mistake, this speech was targeted at the political base.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，这次演讲的目标就是政治基本盘。

sentences.en: It was meant to mollify that base.
sentences.zh: 它是为了安抚那个基本盘。

sentences.en: And I think it's important that we not lose sight of that reality.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们不应忽视这一现实，这一点很重要。

sentences.en: So where does this speech fit into the history of State of the Unions that have come after the dawn of divided government?
sentences.zh: 那么，这次演讲在分裂政府时代以来的国情咨文历史中处于什么位置？

sentences.en: Well, I think what's most significant is that there is really no acknowledgement in this speech of the changed circumstances.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为最显著的是，这次演讲中确实没有承认环境的变化。

sentences.en: There's no acknowledgement here that President Trump faces a new political reality.
sentences.zh: 这里没有承认特朗普总统面临着新的政治现实。

sentences.en: He has to do business with the Democrats if he wants to get any significant legislation passed.
sentences.zh: 如果他想通过任何重要的立法，他就必须与民主党人做生意。

sentences.en: This is the speech given by a president who is behaving very much like he did the week he was inaugurated when he had a unified Congress under his control.
sentences.zh: 这是一位总统发表的演讲，他的表现非常像他刚就职那周的样子，当时他拥有一个由他控制的统一国会。

sentences.en: Does that make this, then, an Obama-like State of the Union?
sentences.zh: 那么，这是否使它成为了一次“奥巴马式”的国情咨文？

sentences.en: I think the difference with President Obama is that while he did not suggest that the defeat in the midterms was really going to change how he approached governing,
sentences.zh: 我认为与奥巴马总统的区别在于，虽然他没有暗示中期选举的失败会真正改变他的执政方式，

sentences.en: he did at least acknowledge the fact that he had suffered an electoral setback in the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 但他至少承认了他在中期选举中遭受了挫折这一事实。

sentences.en: In Mr. Trump's case, he didn't acknowledge the defeat he suffered in the midterm elections, except in a highly indirect way.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普先生的案例中，他没有承认他在中期选举中遭受的失败，除非是以一种非常间接的方式。

sentences.en: And it was actually one of the most remarkable moments of the evening.
sentences.zh: 而且这实际上是当晚最引人注目的时刻之一。

sentences.en: No one has benefited more from a thriving economy than women.
sentences.zh: 没有人比女性从繁荣的经济中受益更多。

sentences.en: President Trump was talking about the increasing numbers of women in the workplace, including in Congress.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统当时正在谈论职场中女性人数的增加，包括在国会中。

sentences.en: And spontaneously, this group of young female Democratic lawmakers rose in unison and began chanting USA and cheering and clapping.
sentences.zh: 随后，这群年轻的女性民主党议员自发地齐声站起来，开始高呼“美国”，并欢呼鼓掌。

sentences.en: Very great.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: And congratulations.
sentences.zh: 祝贺你们。

sentences.en: That's great.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: And the president broke into a smile and appeared, in a funny way, to be taking credit for their presence in the House,
sentences.zh: 总统露出了微笑，并以一种有趣的方式，似乎在为她们出现在众议院而邀功，

sentences.en: which, of course, is deeply ironic because the reason they're in the House is because they were elected largely as a repudiation of him.
sentences.zh: 这当然是非常讽刺的，因为她们出现在众议院的原因，很大程度上是因为她们当选是为了反驳他。

sentences.en: So I think if you're looking for any signs of a newly pragmatic president or a president who will take heed of some of the concerns of the opposing party,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，如果你在寻找一位新务实总统的任何迹象，或者一位会听取反对党某些担忧的总统，

sentences.en: I don't think we saw any of that in the speech tonight.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在今晚的演讲中没有看到任何这些迹象。

sentences.en: And I would not expect to see any of that in his governing style over the next couple of years.
sentences.zh: 而且我也不指望在未来几年的执政风格中看到任何这些迹象。

sentences.en: Well, Mark, it is almost 1 a.m.
sentences.zh: 好了，马克，现在快凌晨1点了。

sentences.en: We are really grateful to you.
sentences.zh: 我们真的很感激你。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: God bless you.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑你。

sentences.en: And God bless America.
sentences.zh: 上帝保佑美国。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: It was a very cool meeting today.
sentences.zh: 今天是一次非常酷的会议。

sentences.en: I'm very happy.
sentences.zh: 我非常高兴。

sentences.en: And we are so excited to be here today.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴今天能来到这里。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, in the latest sign of progress toward a peace deal, leaders of the Taliban met with former high-ranking leaders of the Afghan government,
sentences.zh: 周二，作为迈向和平协议的最新进展迹象，塔利班领导人与阿富汗政府前高级领导人会面，

sentences.en: including its former president in Moscow.
sentences.zh: 其中包括其前总统在莫斯科的会面。

sentences.en: The session excluded the leaders of Afghanistan's current government, who the Taliban views as a U.S.
sentences.zh: 此次会议排除了阿富汗现任政府的领导人，塔利班视他们为美国的

sentences.en: puppet, but was still the most significant contact between the Taliban and Afghan leaders since the U.S.
sentences.zh: 傀儡，但这仍然是自美国

sentences.en: drove the Taliban from power in 2001.
sentences.zh: 在2001年将塔利班赶下台以来，塔利班与阿富汗领导人之间最重要的接触。

sentences.en: We had three good discussions, and inshallah will continue in the future also.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了三次良好的讨论，如果真主保佑，未来还会继续。

sentences.en: And the hope that we can bring peace one day, complete peace in Afghanistan.
sentences.zh: 并希望有一天我们能带来和平，在阿富汗实现彻底的和平。

sentences.en: In a surprising development during the negotiations, the Taliban said it now respected women's rights, including the right to education and work,
sentences.zh: 在谈判中出现了一个令人惊讶的进展，塔利班表示现在尊重女性权利，包括受教育权和工作权，

sentences.en: despite having banned women from public life when the group was in power.
sentences.zh: 尽管该组织在执政时曾禁止女性参与公共生活。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: For example, you wrote in the 1990s that climate change is nothing more than a major environmental boogeyman.
sentences.zh: 例如，您在20世纪90年代写道，气候变化不过是一个重大的环境“妖怪”。

sentences.en: And if the greenhouse effort is a controversial theory pushed by environmental groups, do you still stand by those assertions?
sentences.zh: 如果温室效应是环保组织推动的一种有争议的理论，您现在还坚持这些主张吗？

sentences.en: During a heated confirmation hearing on Tuesday, senators from both parties questioned the past writings of Naomi Rao,
sentences.zh: 在周二一场激烈的确认听证会上，来自两党的参议员质疑了娜奥米·拉奥（Naomi Rao）过去的著作，

sentences.en: President Trump's nominee to replace Brett Kavanaugh, on the powerful federal appeals court in Washington.
sentences.zh: 她是特朗普总统提名的接替布雷特·卡瓦诺（Brett Kavanaugh）进入华盛顿强有力的联邦上诉法院的人选。

sentences.en: You know, Senator Leahy, those are statements from college, as you said, a few decades old, when I think some of these issues were more hotly debated.
sentences.zh: 您知道，莱希参议员，正如您所说，那是大学时期的言论，已有几十年了，当时我认为其中一些问题争论得更为激烈。

sentences.en: And no, I mean, I think the science has become much more conclusive over time.
sentences.zh: 不，我的意思是，我认为随着时间的推移，科学已经变得更加确凿。

sentences.en: Conclusive in what way?
sentences.zh: 在哪些方面确凿？

sentences.en: Well, I think they're, you know, my understanding is that there's an overwhelming scientific consensus that there is climate change.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为，据我了解，科学界对于存在气候变化这一事实有着压倒性的共识。

sentences.en: Senators repeatedly asked Rao to explain a series of provocative columns she wrote.
sentences.zh: 参议员们反复要求拉奥解释她写的一系列挑衅性专栏文章。

sentences.en: as a college student, expressing skepticism about global warming, and calling equality between women and men a dangerous concept.
sentences.zh: 作为一名大学生，她曾对全球变暖表示怀疑，并称男女平等是一个危险的概念。

sentences.en: A dangerous feminist ideal is that women are created equal.
sentences.zh: 一个危险的女权主义理想是女性生而平等。

sentences.en: Senator, I very much regret that statement.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我非常后悔发表那样的言论。

sentences.en: And I've always believed strongly in the equality of women and men and for equal rights and opportunities for women.
sentences.zh: 我一直坚定地相信男女平等，并支持女性享有平等的权利和机会。

sentences.en: I'm honestly not sure why I wrote that in college.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不确定为什么我在大学时会写下那些话。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》（The Daily）。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗（Michael Barbaro）。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》（Metro）节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格（Sarah Koenig）将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》节目。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在您获取播客的任何地方收听。
